title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.38637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. translated_title: 基于教师进化的在线策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过将学生模型的词元级分布与由特权上下文提示的自教师模型的分布对齐，已成为缓解序列级后训练范式中奖励稀疏性的一种有前景的方向。然而，OPSD 在训练过程中往往无法实现持续的性能提升。在本文中，我们发现这一现象的根本原因在于模型有限的自教学能力，导致其在某些样本上生成不可靠的指导。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了教师进化自蒸馏（TESD），使自教师能够生成推演（rollouts），并根据任务正确性和上下文独立性接收环境反馈。首先，我们将这些奖励作为训练目标，进行面向教师的优化，从而在蒸馏过程中持续增强模型的自教学能力。其次，通过从教师指导中估计可靠性……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出教师进化自蒸馏（TESD）方法，通过让自教师模型生成推演并根据任务正确性与上下文独立性获得环境反馈、以教师导向优化持续增强其自教学能力，从而解决了在线策略自蒸馏因自教师指导不可靠而无法持续提升性能的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which lets the self-teacher generate rollouts, receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence, and undergo teacher-oriented optimization to continuously improve its self-teaching capability, addressing the unreliable guidance that prevents On-Policy Self-Distillation from achieving sustained performance gains.
